How to drive

  • W/↑ throttle · S/↓/Space brake · A/D or ←/→ steer · R reset to track · C camera · Esc pause
  • Brake in a straight line before the corner; the tyres can only give so much grip for braking and turning together.
  • Cross the start/finish line to begin timing. Lap 1 is timed from that crossing.
  • Going past the kerb edge or pressing R invalidates the current lap. It stays invalid for that lap.
  • Δ = current − best valid lap at the same track position (negative = faster).
  • More downforce: faster corners, slower top speed.

About

Milano Racing Simulator is an original browser game: planar bicycle-model physics with a tanh tyre model, aerodynamic drag/downforce, a spline circuit, fixed 120 Hz simulation. No official logo asset was supplied, so a typographic wordmark is used. No team results or sponsors are claimed.
